name: What is involved in the roof replacement process?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the roof replacement process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The roof replacement process typically involves several steps: initial inspection and estimate, removal of the old roofing material, inspection of the roof deck, necessary repairs, installation of underlayment and new flashing, installation of the new roofing material, and a thorough clean-up. We ensure all debris is removed and your property is left tidy.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes inspection, removal of old materials, deck repair, installation of underlayment and new roofing, followed by a complete cleanup.
